# cloudminator_project (Resource)

A project inside an organization. The slug is derived from the name at creation and never changes; renaming changes only the display name. An organization's last project cannot be deleted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudminator_project" "prod" {
  name = "Production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name. Changing it renames the project in place.

### Optional

- `org` (String) Organization slug. Defaults to the provider's `org`. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Project slug.
- `slug` (String) Project slug, used as `project` on other resources.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a project by organization and project slug.
terraform import cloudminator_project.prod acme/production
```
